components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main CTA surface. Parchment cream background signals action in the archive palette.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #fcf8d8; color: #1f150c; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 32px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transition: background-color 0.15s, transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #f0e6b8; transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fbbf24; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Glass-dark button for back-navigation and secondary overlaid actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background-color: rgba(31,39,55,0.8); color: #ffffff; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); transition: background-color 0.15s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: rgba(55,65,81,0.9); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fbbf24; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-event-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden; border-radius:12px; box-shadow:0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); transition:transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); cursor:pointer; text-decoration:none; background-color:rgba(31,21,12,0.64); color:#ffffff; position:relative; } .ds-event-card:hover { transform:scale(1.02); box-shadow:0 25px 50px -12px rgba(59,130,246,0.2); } .ds-event-card__image { height:224px; background-size:cover; background-position:center; flex-shrink:0; position:relative; } .ds-event-card__category { position:absolute; top:16px; left:16px; border-radius:9999px; padding:4px 12px; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#ffffff; } .ds-cat-espacio { background-color:rgba(37,99,235,0.85); } .ds-event-card__body { display:flex; flex-direction:column; flex-grow:1; padding:24px; gap:8px; } .ds-event-card__date { font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; opacity:0.7; margin:0; } .ds-event-card__title { font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif; font-size:1.25rem; font-weight:700; margin:0; line-height:1.3; } .ds-event-card__summary { font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif; font-size:1rem; line-height:1.6; margin:0; display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:3; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; overflow:hidden; opacity:0.85; } .ds-event-card__cta { font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; margin-top:8px; align-self:flex-start; color:#ffffff; opacity:0.7; transition:opacity 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-event-card:hover .ds-event-card__cta { opacity:1; color:#93c5fd; }

narrative.overview:
Epicstoria's visual world is built on the metaphor of a great imperial archive — a solemn hall lit by amber lanterns, its walls lined with dark stone, its cases holding parchment scrolls sealed in gold. The visitor doesn't feel like they're browsing a website; they feel like they've been granted access to a repository of civilization's most consequential moments. The darkness is not menacing: it's the reverent quiet of a space where important things are kept.

The palette speaks this architecture directly. Deep leather and ink dark form the structural shell: the header, containers, and overlays. Warm parchment and cream ivory surface the content layers, creating the tactile sense of old paper under light. Gold amber burns as the single interactive voice — a flame in the archive — marking every hover state, focus ring, and interactive icon.

The character is adventurous and warm, not academic or intimidating. History is presented as treasure, not curriculum. The scale transforms that animate buttons and cards reinforce this: the archive responds to the curious visitor who leans in.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-dark layering: leather containers float over a beige-textured background, never on pure white or black
Amber as the single interactive voice; no competing accent color
Full-bleed hero images as the primary storytelling surface at every event entry point
Scale transforms (not opacity) as the tactile hover response
Parchment cream for all primary CTAs — never blue, never generic

rules.name: La Regla del Pergamino
rules.body: Primary CTAs use cream-ivory (#fcf8d8) with leather text (#1f150c). Never blue, never white, never transparent.

rules.name: La Regla del Oro Único
rules.body: Amber is the one interactive accent. Do not introduce a second color for hover, focus, or link states.

rules.name: La Regla de Poppins
rules.body: One typeface, one family. Inter is not promoted to body usage. Satisfy is restricted to brand-name display on auth screens.

rules.name: La Regla de la Sombra Azul
rules.body: The only colored shadow is the blue glow on event card hover. Do not apply it to any other component type.

dos: Do use #fcf8d8 (cream-ivory) as the background for every primary CTA.
Do use amber (#fbbf24) as the sole interactive accent — hover, focus rings, icon tints.
Do use rgba(31,21,12,0.64) with border-radius 12px and shadow-2xl as the standard content container.
Do use full-bleed cover images for event entries.
Do animate with scale transforms (scale(1.02) for cards, scale(1.05) for buttons).
Do use Poppins 900 (font-black) for display-level titles.
donts: Don't use pure white (#ffffff) as a surface background.
Don't introduce new accent colors — blue and red are structural/semantic, not general-purpose.
Don't use the Satisfy font (title-font) for anything other than the 'Epicstoria' brand name on auth screens.
Don't apply the blue hover glow (shadow-blue-500/20) to anything other than event cards.
Don't mix the pill shape (action layer) with rounded-xl (container layer).
